item.title: Three Kerry businesses recognised at the Great Place to Work awards
item.description: Three Kerry businesses have been recognised at the Great Place to Work awards. The Gleneagle in Killarney, which has approximately 350 employees, took a place on Ireland’s Best Large Workplaces 2026 list. Enercon in Tralee, with its 203 employees made the Best Medium Workplaces list. Advertisement While, O'Callaghan Coaches in Killarney, which employees 89 people, came second on the list of Ireland's Best Small Workplaces. item.title: Kerry's Sneem Hotel in France with Tourism Ireland to attract tourists
item.description: Nine tourism companies from Ireland, including Kerry's Sneem Hotel, are in France with Tourism Ireland this week. They are taking part in a series of Lunch & Learn events in Lyon, Rennes and Nantes. The events gives tourism companies from Ireland the chance to connect with French travel agents and tour operators, to win a greater share of the French market. Advertisement

item.title: Ireland go in search of first win of EuroBasket qualifying campaign tonight
item.description: The Ireland men's basketball team go in search of the first win of their EuroBasket qualifying campaign tonight. Michael Bree's side face Azerbaijan in Tallaght, with tip-off at half 7. Advertisement

item.title: Donegan has dream debut on Ladies European Tour
item.description: Áine Donegan has enjoyed a dream debut on the Ladies European Tour, moving in a two-shot lead at the midway point of the Ford Women's NSW Open. The Clare golfer carded a second-round 63 today, to sit on 11-under-par. Dublin's Anna Foster is three-under heading into the weekend. Advertisement

item.title: Former Kerry garda station sold for €200,000 at auction
item.description: A former Kerry garda station was sold for €200,000 at auction yesterday. Estate agents ERA Downey McCarthy brought the former Brosna garda station to the market by public auction, which was held yesterday. The detached, two-storey station in the middle of the village closed in January 2013 and was transferred to the OPW. item.title: Original works from historic Disney films on show at Siamsa Tíre exhibition
item.description: Original drawings from historic films including Disney’s Snow White are on show at an exhibition opening in Siamsa Tíre today. Animation Is Art, presented by Animation Dingle, is a major exhibition at the Siamsa Tíre Art Gallery in Tralee running from today until 19th March. The exhibition includes original works connected to films such as Snow White, The Jungle Book, and The Lord of the Rings and Soul. item.title: Information Day for Kerry Rose contestants this Sunday in Tralee
item.description: An information day for anyone interested in becoming the next Kerry Rose, is to be held in Tralee this Sunday. The event is an opportunity for all potential candidates to find out about the application process, and ask any questions that might arise. The winning Kerry Rose will be crowned at a selection event on April 18th, and will take over from 2025 Kerry Rose, Laura Daly. Advertisement Sunday's information day begins at 12 noon at Ballyroe Lodge, Tralee.
